name: web-networking
title: Web networking: DNS, TLS, HTTP, CDN and proxies
summary: Configure and debug everything between the browser and the app: IP and transport, DNS and domains, TLS, HTTP and its caching, CDN and edge protection, reverse proxies and load balancers.
useWhen: My domain does not resolve or a DNS change has not shown up
Set up DNS records and HTTPS for a new domain
The certificate expired or browsers show a TLS error
I get a 502, 503 or 504 and do not know which hop caused it
Configure nginx, Caddy or a load balancer in front of the app
Put a CDN in front of the site and set cache headers and purging
The site is under a DDoS or bots and scrapers are hammering it
Enable HTTP/3 or work out why connections are slow
Users in one region or on mobile networks cannot connect

notFor.topic: CORS errors, Content Security Policy and other security headers
SPF, DKIM, DMARC and email landing in spam
Building WebSocket, SSE or WebRTC features
VPCs, subnets, security groups and private cloud networking
Page-load speed, Core Web Vitals and image delivery
Login rate limits, credential stuffing and signup bots
